input.question: Which person or organization did Vikram Misra work for?

documents.text: As the sun set over the rolling hills of West Lafayette, Indiana, Dr. Vikram Misra made his way across the Purdue University campus, his worn leather satchel slung over his shoulder. The crunch of fallen leaves beneath his feet was a familiar soundtrack, one that had accompanied him on countless walks between the engineering buildings and his office in the Electrical Engineering department. It was a crisp autumn evening in 2015, and Vikram was lost in thought, his mind still reeling from the breakthrough he had made in his lab that morning. His research team had been working tirelessly to develop a more efficient solar cell, and finally, after months of trial and error, they had cracked the code. The implications were enormous, and Vikram couldn't wait to share the news with his colleagues. As he approached the Neil Armstrong Hall of Engineering, he nodded to the familiar faces of his colleagues, exchanging brief hellos and nods of acknowledgement. The building was a hub of activity, with students and faculty members hurrying to and from classes, meetings, and research sessions. Vikram had spent countless hours within these walls, pouring over research papers, conducting experiments, and mentoring students. He pushed open the door to his office, a cozy space cluttered with books, papers, and various gadgets. A whiteboard covered in equations and diagrams dominated one wall, while a shelf overflowing with awards and certificates testified to his accomplishments. Vikram dropped his satchel onto the worn couch, taking a moment to collect his thoughts before diving into the task of drafting a paper on their breakthrough. As he sat down at his desk, his gaze fell upon a framed photo of his research team, taken during a celebratory dinner at the Purdue Memorial Union. The memory brought a smile to his face, and he felt a sense of pride and belonging. This was his home, where he had spent years honing his craft, collaborating with brilliant minds, and pushing the boundaries of innovation.
